_comment: Release quality gate for main. Import via GitHub → Settings → Rules →
Rulesets → New ruleset → Import a ruleset, or apply with:
gh api -X POST /repos/agnusdei-ai/bede/rulesets --input .github/rulesets/main-branch-protection.json
Branch protection is NOT repo-as-code on GitHub — this file is the
reviewable source of truth, but importing it is a manual admin action and
editing this file alone changes nothing. Confirm with:
gh api /repos/agnusdei-ai/bede/rulesets
THE POINT OF strict_required_status_checks_policy: it is 'require branches
to be up to date before merging'. Without it, two PRs that each pass CI
alone can break main together — which is exactly what happened on
2026-08-03, when #364 added an endpoint and #366 added the guard table
requiring every endpoint to have an entry. Neither PR's CI could see the
other. main went red on the merge.
NO BYPASS ACTORS, deliberately. An earlier draft carried an
`actor_id: 5` RepositoryRole entry meant to be "repository admin" —
written from memory rather than checked. A wrong id there fails in the
worse direction than it looks: rather than erroring, it can grant
standing bypass to a role nobody chose, leaving a gate that reports as
enforced and is not. An empty list has no such ambiguity — the rule
applies to everyone, including the owner.
That is also the right posture for a quality gate. An emergency merge
stays possible by disabling this ruleset, which is a visible act with
an audit trail rather than a permanent exemption nobody re-reads.
PREREQUISITE, and it is not optional: every workflow named below must
START on every pull request. A required check that never runs leaves the
PR blocked forever on 'Expected — waiting for status to be reported', not
merged as passing. Both workflows previously carried a paths: filter on
their pull_request trigger, so a docs-only PR would have been permanently
unmergeable. They now always start and skip their heavy jobs internally —
a SKIPPED job satisfies a required check, a job that never ran does not.
Do not re-add a pull_request paths: filter to a workflow listed here.
name: main release quality gate
